title: Exam form submission
text: Semester exam forms must be filled online on the college portal between 1 and 15 November 2026. Late forms are accepted until 20 November with a fine of Rs 500.

title: Scholarship application
text: The state post-matric scholarship form is open until 30 November 2026. Required documents: income certificate, Aadhaar, previous marksheet, bank passbook copy. Submit at Room 12, Accounts Office, 10 am to 4 pm.

title: Fee payment
text: Semester fee can be paid online or at the bank counter by 10 November 2026. Fee in instalments is allowed only with a written request to the Principal.

title: Hostel allotment
text: Hostel forms are available at the warden office. Last date is 25 October 2026. The merit list will be put up on 2 November 2026.

title: ID card and bonafide certificate
text: New ID cards are issued at the Admin Office in 3 working days. A bonafide certificate needs a form signed by the class coordinator and takes 2 working days.

title: Re-evaluation
text: Re-evaluation requests must be made within 7 days of result declaration. Fee is Rs 300 per paper. Apply on the exam portal under Re-evaluation.

title: Library
text: Library is open 9 am to 6 pm, Monday to Saturday. Each student can borrow 3 books for 14 days. Late fine is Rs 2 per day.

title: UG admission documents
text: For UG admission, bring original and two self-attested copies of: Class 10 and Class 12 marksheets, Transfer Certificate, Migration Certificate (for non-state board students), Category certificate if applicable, and 4 passport-size photographs.

title: Office timings
text: Administrative office is open Monday to Friday, 9:00 am to 5:00 pm. Cashier counter is open 10 am to 3:30 pm. Lunch break is 1:00 pm to 2:00 pm. Office is closed on Saturday and Sunday.

title: Fee structure (UG)
text: Tuition fee for UG programs is Rs 45,000 per semester. Exam fee is Rs 1,500 and development fee is Rs 3,000 per semester.

title: Admission counselling
text: Provisional admission counselling is on 5 to 7 August 2026 at the Admin Block. Seat acceptance fee is Rs 10,000 and is adjusted in the first semester fee.

title: Semester dates
text: Odd semester classes run from 3 August to 20 November 2026. Mid-semester tests are from 21 to 26 September 2026. Even semester begins on 4 January 2027.

title: Holidays
text: College holidays: Dussehra on 20 October 2026, Diwali break from 8 to 12 November 2026, Christmas on 25 December 2026, Republic Day on 26 January 2027.

title: End-semester exam schedule
text: End-semester exams start on 1 December 2026. The datesheet will be on the exam portal by 20 November 2026. Admit cards are available 5 days before the first exam.

title: Hostel and mess fees
text: Hostel fee is Rs 38,000 per year, payable in two instalments. Mess charges are Rs 3,200 per month.

title: Hostel rules
text: Hostel gate closes at 10 pm. Visitors are allowed on Sunday from 4 pm to 6 pm in the visitor room only. Overnight outside guests are not allowed.

title: Local guardian rule
text: Students whose local guardian lives within 25 km of campus are normally treated as day scholars. Any exemption can be granted only by the Chief Warden.

title: Supplementary exam
text: Supplementary exam forms are open from 10 to 20 January 2027. Fee is Rs 800 per paper. Apply on the exam portal.

title: Exam rules and attendance
text: Carry your college ID card and admit card to every exam. Mobile phones are not allowed in the hall. 75 percent attendance is required to sit the exam. With a medical certificate, the minimum is 65 percent.

title: Helpdesk contact
text: Helpdesk is at Admin Block, Room 4, open Monday to Friday, 9 am to 5 pm. Email: helpdesk@college.example. Phone: 0612-000000. These are demo contact details.

title: Grievance process
text: Submit the grievance form at the Registrar Office or on the portal. The office replies within 5 working days.
